A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same SW-Guidance work. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, and complete appendices are readable and support reliable matching despite substantial reformatting.

before.justification: v1 reports original SD1.5 and SDXL evaluations, quantitative baseline comparisons, ablations, timing measurements, and qualitative generation results.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and adds a content-diversity evaluation using FID in Appendix C.

M1.justification: Algorithms 1 and 2 retain the same control-vector optimization, Sliced Wasserstein loss, optional moment terms, and DDIM sampling procedure. The SD1.5 gradient normalization and SDXL implementation remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the first 1000 ContraStyles prompts and 1000 Unsplash Lite references, with the same color-conditioning and ControlNet scenarios. The added FID analysis evaluates existing generated-image coverage; grayscale conversion is evaluation preprocessing.

E2.justification: Comparator memberships in the retained quantitative and ablation comparisons are unchanged. The new FID analysis reuses previously evaluated moments-only and stylized-generation methods. Color Alignment in Diffusion is newly cited but explicitly excluded from evaluation.

E3.justification: Appendix C introduces FID against unconditional SDXL outputs after grayscale conversion and histogram normalization. Existing generation settings remain unchanged. Table 5's SDXL heading conflicts with Appendix D's Stable Cascade description for RB-Modulation, so a backbone change cannot be established.

E4.justification: v2 adds the FID-based content-diversity analysis and a pilot illustration comparing stylization methods. Existing distance, moment, learning-rate, and computational-cost ablations are retained. The runtime study moves into the main text, while the learning-rate study moves to the appendix.

E5.justification: Existing tables retain their 'mean ± std of mean' reporting, and the plots retain error bars. No new run counts, seeds, uncertainty procedures, or significance tests are supplied. The added FID table reports point estimates only.

E6.justification: All 102 score-and-uncertainty entries in Tables 1–4 are unchanged. New Table 5 reports FID values of 53.16 for moments-only, 58.40 for SW-Guidance, 58.95 for InstantStyle, 71.06 for IP-Adapter, and 72.75 for RB-Modulation. Some qualitative examples are added or removed.

T1.justification: The Wasserstein definitions, main-text Proposition 1 and Lemma 2, and their complete appendix proofs are retained. Changes to mathematical presentation are formatting and citation renumbering, without substantive revisions.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution statements, and conclusion retain the same claims: training-free Sliced Wasserstein guidance, superior reference-palette matching, and preservation of prompt coherence without unwanted stylistic transfer.

C2.justification: Appendix C newly interprets FID as evidence that SW-Guidance preserves content diversity comparable to InstantStyle and greater than IP-Adapter and RB-Modulation, with a tradeoff against moments-only matching. Existing limitations concerning conflicting prompts, attention-based stylization, and U-Net differentiation remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The new checklist supplies an additional anonymous source-code link and a conditional plan to publish evaluation data. Their availability is not verified by the PDFs. Existing hyperparameters, metric implementations, hardware information, and the public GitHub link are retained.

R1.justification: v2 adds Shum et al.'s Color Alignment in Diffusion and explains its exclusion from direct comparison because an open-source implementation was unavailable. It removes the Adaptive Instance Normalization citation and associated discussion. The broader research positioning remains stable.

P1.justification: The introduction is condensed, experimental prose is reorganized, figure references are corrected, and a NeurIPS checklist is added. Affiliations and appendix labels change. The principal section sequence and most method, theory, and limitations prose remain intact.

P2.justification: The document changes from two-column to single-column presentation. Tables 1–4 align all metrics by method instead of using separately ordered panels. Figures are extensively rearranged, resized, relocated, and selectively revised; the opening montage is redesigned and Table 5 is added.

improvement.justification: Aligned comparison tables, corrected figure references, and acknowledgment of directly related work improve clarity and context. The added FID analysis modestly extends the evidence, although its diversity interpretation and inconsistent RB-Modulation backbone labeling limit its conclusiveness. The method, proofs, and original quantitative findings remain unchanged.
